WordScreen for KOReader v0.4.3 — integrated playback and spelling practice

简体中文：
1. 完全退出 KOReader。
2. 通过 USB 连接 Kindle，备份 koreader/plugins/wordscreen.koplugin/ 和 koreader/settings/wordscreen_koreader.lua。
3. 将本仓库或 GitHub 源码 ZIP 中的 koreader/ 文件夹复制到 Kindle USB 根目录，允许合并/覆盖。
4. 安全弹出 Kindle，重新启动 KOReader。
5. 打开原来的每词两页 PDF，在工具/更多工具中打开 WordScreen。
6. 拼写模式只使用 B 页；键盘直接弹出；答对自动跳词；答错保存错题、显示答案，手动滑动继续。
7. 不要删除 wordscreen_koreader.lua，其中保存收藏、播放设置和错题记录。无需替换 PDF。

English:
1. Completely exit KOReader.
2. Connect the Kindle by USB. Back up koreader/plugins/wordscreen.koplugin/ and koreader/settings/wordscreen_koreader.lua.
3. Copy the koreader/ folder from this repository or the GitHub source ZIP to the Kindle USB root; merge/overwrite.
4. Safely eject the Kindle and restart KOReader.
5. Open the existing two-page-per-word PDF and find WordScreen in Tools / More tools.
6. Spelling mode uses B pages only. The virtual keyboard appears directly; correct answers advance automatically; wrong answers are saved and revealed, then swipe manually to continue.
7. Keep wordscreen_koreader.lua: it stores favorites, playback settings and spelling mistakes. The PDF does not need to be replaced.

User-confirmed on Kindle Paperwhite 1 + KOReader 2026.07.1. Other device/firmware combinations are not yet declared compatible.
